question: Should memory-lancedb permanently expose these three advanced auto-recall knobs, including an injection cap up to 50 and overfetch up to 200, under the proposed config contract?
rationale: Repository policy deliberately limits new config surface, and code review cannot decide whether operator selectivity outweighs the permanent API and prompt-budget burden.

options.title: Approve bounded tuning
options.body: Accept the opt-in plugin settings after confirming their final names and obtaining real live-hook proof with the proposed operational bounds.

options.title: Narrow the surface
options.body: Expose only the minimum-score control or reduce the maximum cap and overfetch values to limit configuration and availability risk.

options.title: Keep internal defaults
options.body: Decline new config and retain the current hardcoded selectivity until a stronger recurring operator need is established.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded tuning
recommendation.body: Accept the opt-in plugin settings after confirming their final names and obtaining real live-hook proof with the proposed operational bounds.
